question: Odissi Guru, _______ received the first Utkal Pratibha Samman 2023 at Bhubaneswar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratikant Mohapatra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Ratikant Mohapatra:**

 
 
• Ratikant Mohapatra is a renowned Odissi dancer and choreographer. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• He is the son of the legendary Odissi Guru, Kelucharan Mohapatra. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• He is the director of Srjan, an Odissi dance institution founded by his father.
